map_source: Ground-level 2D station layout plan supplied by the team (map.png).

map_scale.source: Scale bar printed on the plan: 0–50 m spans 281 px.

notes: Schematic layout, not surveyed and not to scale. Node and pathway positions were traced by hand from the team-supplied plan image (map.png); every node and pathway is pending on-site verification.
Accessibility of every pathway is unknown. Nothing here is a verified accessibility claim.
Distances are not measured; any distance shown is an estimate from the plan scale bar.
Pathways with verification 'simulated' (sug_*) were suggested by proximity where the plan shows no clear walkway.

geo_reference.source: Station coordinate (13.0825 N, 80.2750 E, Wikipedia) pinned to the main concourse; plan treated as north-up per its compass; scale from the plan's scale bar.
